# Astrometrics

> A desktop app and two Python libraries for astrophotography, photometry, spectroscopy and observatory control. astrometricslib turns telescope frames into measurements; wayfindinglib plans, runs and protects an observing night. This file maps each topic to the documents that explain it and the code that implements it. Read the documents first to learn what something is meant to do and where it lives, then confirm in the code. When a document and the code disagree, the code is the current behavior: say so and treat the document as needing a fix.

Paths are relative to the repository root. Theory is in the architecture papers, code names and tuned values in the implementation papers, and evidence in the validation register (documentation/Documentation_Conventions.md, Section 1). Terms are in documentation/Glossary.md.

## Start here

- [About these docs](documentation/About_These_Docs.md): the map of every document, its kind and what checks it.
- [Documentation conventions](documentation/Documentation_Conventions.md): where each kind of content lives and the rules the documents follow.
- [Glossary](documentation/Glossary.md): definitions of the terms used everywhere.
- [Installation](documentation/Installation.md): setting up the app and its environment.
- [Library quick start](documentation/how_to/library_quick_start.md): a first call to the Python library.

## Image processing (astrometricslib)

- [Astrometrics library architecture](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Library_Architecture.md): the theory of every pipeline, with the equations. Code: astrometricslib/.
- [Astrometrics library implementation](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Library_Implementation.md): the modules, classes and tuned values behind each section of the architecture paper.
- [Data models](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Library_Architecture.md#2-observational-data-models): targets, frames, camera profiles and provenance. Code: astrometricslib/models/.
- [Stacking](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Library_Architecture.md#3-image-stacking-pipeline): calibration and stacking. Guide: documentation/library_design/pipelines/stacking.md. README: astrometricslib/pipelines/stacking/README.md. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/stacking.md.
- [Astrometry](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Library_Architecture.md#4-astrometry-pipeline): star detection, plate solving and the Gaia refit. Guide: documentation/library_design/pipelines/astrometry.md. README: astrometricslib/pipelines/astrometry/README.md. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/astrometry.md.
- [Photometry](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Library_Architecture.md#5-stellar-photometry-pipeline): aperture photometry, the comparison ensemble, variability and period search. Guide: documentation/library_design/pipelines/photometry.md. README: astrometricslib/pipelines/photometry/README.md. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/photometry.md.
- [Spectroscopy](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Library_Architecture.md#6-stellar-spectroscopy-pipeline): slitless extraction, wavelength and flux calibration, classification. Guide: documentation/library_design/pipelines/spectroscopy.md. README: astrometricslib/pipelines/spectroscopy/README.md. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/spectroscopy.md.
- [Asteroid detection](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Library_Architecture.md#7-asteroid-detection-pipeline): chaining detections and straight-line motion tests. Guide: documentation/library_design/pipelines/asteroid_detection.md. README: astrometricslib/pipelines/asteroid_detection/README.md. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/asteroid_detection.md.
- [Astrometrics quality measurements](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md): the theory of the numbers the library measures from its data, with no pass or fail judgment. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/index.md.
- [Quality measurement principles](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#2-principles): measure and never interpret, store parts and not ratios, not measured with a reason, and each measurement's purpose.
- [Gain and read noise](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#3-camera-noise-from-calibration-frames): the conversion gain and read noise from flat and bias pairs. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/stacking.md (STK-35). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/stacking/pre_processing/sensor_noise.py.
- [Expected noise in an empty aperture](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#41-the-noise-the-frames-predict): the noise a stack's frames predict from sky and read noise. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/stacking.md (STK-38). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/stacking/post_processing/expected_noise.py.
- [Empty apertures and the faint-source mask](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#42-choosing-empty-apertures): choosing apertures by a rule blind to their own sums. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/stacking.md (STK-36). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/stacking/post_processing/empty_apertures.py.
- [The master flat's pattern in an aperture](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#43-the-master-flats-pattern-in-an-aperture): the fixed noise the flat adds. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/stacking.md (STK-39). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/stacking/post_processing/flat_noise_contribution.py.
- [Noise growth and half-stack difference](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#44-how-the-noise-falls-with-frame-count): how stack noise falls with frame count, and the planned half-stack difference. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/stacking.md (STK-36, STK-37). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/stacking/subset_stack.py.
- [Effective star width](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#51-the-effective-star-width): the Moffat star width and the pixel term. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/astrometry.md (AST-17, AST-18). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/shared/quality/frame_measurement.py.
- [Star width across the field](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#52-star-width-across-the-field): the center against the four corners. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/astrometry.md (AST-18). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/shared/quality/frame_measurement.py.
- [Field rotation](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#53-field-rotation): the rotation angle of each frame about the registration reference. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/stacking.md (STK-43). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/stacking/post_processing/field_rotation.py.
- [Half-stack shared pattern](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#46-what-the-halves-share-at-fine-scale): the part of any fixed pattern that stays coherent in both halves of a stack, and whether a drift smears it. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/stacking.md (STK-45). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/stacking/post_processing/half_pattern.py.
- [Registration step and pointing drift](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#55-registration-step-and-pointing-drift): the step between exposures and the drift of the pointing, per stack. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/stacking.md (STK-44). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/stacking/post_processing/registration_shifts.py.
- [Target clipping](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#54-target-clipping): the share of the target's pixels at the clip ceiling or beyond the linearity limit. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/astrometry.md (AST-19). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/astrometry/post_processing/target_clipping.py.
- [Catalog zero point](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#6-catalog-zero-point-of-a-frame): the differential zero point of each frame against a fixed star set. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/photometry.md (PHO-15). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/photometry/processing/catalog_zero_point.py.
- [Expected position residual](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#7-expected-position-residual): the centroid noise, pixel phase and Gaia epoch parts of the distance to a Gaia position. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/astrometry.md (AST-21). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/astrometry/post_processing/expected_residual.py.
- [Noise of a photometric measurement](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#8-noise-of-a-photometric-measurement): photon, sky, read and scintillation noise by source. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/photometry.md (PHO-17). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/photometry/processing/noise_budget.py.
- [Window function of the observing times](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#91-the-window-function-of-the-observing-times): the alias peaks a run's schedule cannot separate. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/photometry.md (PHO-18). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/photometry/processing/observing_window.py.
- [The target's amplitude](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#92-the-targets-amplitude): the folded light-curve amplitude and the VSX catalog amplitude, kept apart. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/photometry.md (PHO-19). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/photometry/processing/target_amplitude.py.
- [Signal-to-noise and the spectral class](documentation/library_design/Astrometrics_Quality_Measurements.md#10-signal-to-noise-and-the-spectral-class): the signal-to-noise at the classifying lines and the class gap against signal-to-noise. Evidence: documentation/library_design/validation/spectroscopy.md (SPE-30). Code: astrometricslib/pipelines/spectroscopy/processing/class_gap_calibration.py.
- [Shared pipeline code](astrometricslib/pipelines/shared/README.md): helpers used by several pipelines.
- [Public API](astrometricslib/api/README.md): the Astrometrics entry point and its catalogs. Reference: documentation/api/astrometricslib.rst.
- [Validation register](documentation/library_design/validation/index.md): how each tuned value was checked, with the library calls to repeat the check.

## Observatory control (wayfindinglib)

- [Wayfinding library architecture](documentation/library_design/Wayfinding_Library_Architecture.md): the theory of planning, execution and control. Code: wayfindinglib/.
- [Wayfinding library implementation](documentation/library_design/Wayfinding_Library_Implementation.md): the modules, classes and settings behind each section of the architecture paper.
- [System architecture and delegation](documentation/library_design/Wayfinding_Library_Architecture.md#2-system-architecture): the three functions and how work moves from the incumbent software to this system.
- [Foundation](documentation/library_design/Wayfinding_Library_Architecture.md#3-foundation-equipment-site-and-session-domain): equipment, site and session records. Code: wayfindinglib/models/.
- [Observation planning](documentation/library_design/Wayfinding_Library_Architecture.md#4-observation-planning): placing imaging requests in a night. Code: wayfindinglib/api/planning.py, wayfindinglib/tasks/.
- [Observation execution](documentation/library_design/Wayfinding_Library_Architecture.md#5-observation-execution): running a planned night and recovering from faults. Code: wayfindinglib/tasks/execution_tasks/.
- [Observatory control](documentation/library_design/Wayfinding_Library_Architecture.md#6-observatory-control): device control, safety and the safe state. Code: wayfindinglib/tasks/control_tasks/, wayfindinglib/drivers/.
- [Session analysis](wayfindinglib/session_analysis/README.md): guiding and image-quality analysis of past nights.
- Reference: documentation/api/wayfindinglib.rst.

- [Desktop app architecture](documentation/user_interface/technical_reference/User_Interface_Architecture.md): Electron, React and how the app talks to the backend. Code: ui/, electron/, backend/, and the interface in backend/public_interface.py.
- [User manual](documentation/user_interface/user_guides/User_Manual.md): every view and control.
- [Observatory control guide](documentation/user_interface/user_guides/Observatory_Control_and_Automation_Guide.md): task recipes for running the telescope from the app.
